request.prompt: Field-guide side view of a wild turkey tom (Meleagris gallopavo) walking calmly while foraging, the ordinary resting posture, NOT strutting, NOT displaying. Tail feathers closed together into one narrow bundle that points backward and slightly down, not fanned, not spread, not raised. Wings folded neatly up on the back, the wing tips resting on the rump above the tail, not drooping. One bird, no base. Clean closed mesh.
